retrieval_policy.default_for_links: A URL is a discovery lead, not proof of availability, authority, license, completeness, or unit status.
later_retrieval_requirements: retrieve only within the explicit authority and network policy of the later job
do not bypass authentication, paywalls, robots controls, or other access restrictions
record final URL, retrieval result, provenance, content hash, access date, license or usage terms, and classification
inspect content before naming, ordering, or scheduling an official unit
keep solutions, hidden tests, examiner notes, and restricted content outside every learner-visible path
do not copy or redistribute content when rights are absent or unclear
preserve failed retrieval evidence rather than changing LINKED to AVAILABLE based on a prose claim
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: Only validated, authorized, content-bearing records may become later schedulable units; external validators, not learner or worker prose, decide readiness.
